newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Fire heavily damages Jakarta shopping complex.
newsitem.headline: Fire heavily damages Jakarta shopping complex.

text.p: About 250 shops and a Matahari department store were destroyed or damaged when fire swept through a shopping complex in central Jakarta on Monday, police and eyewitnesses said.
There were no reports of casualties from the blaze, which police said broke out around 5:30 a.m. on the second floor of the four-storey building in the Pasar Baru area.
"The Matahari store appears to be badly damaged," an eyewitness said. Many of the shops dealt in electrical equipment and cameras.
In another area of central Jakarta, eyewitnesses said street vendors set a car ablaze and overturned several others after officials ordered them to move their stalls, which were blocking the street.
Eyewitnesses said about 50 soldiers with rattan canes, shields and teargas canisters cordoned off the Tanah Abang textile district to restore order.
One witness said the trouble started after an official's car had accidentally hit one of the vendors. There were no reports of casualties.
At least 10 people were arrested following a gang war in mid-January in the same area.
Tanah Abang is an important area for the textile trade in Jakarta and home to a number of banks.
